versions.changelog:
Version 0.2.0 of hologres-uv-compute introduces real-time UV/PV computation pipelines using Hologres Dynamic Tables and RoaringBitmap.

- Enables sub-second, scalable UV/PV aggregation over billions of records with low latency.
- Provides ready-to-use SQL templates for table setup, dynamic incremental aggregation, and querying across any time range.
- Supports dimension-based and global UV/PV queries using efficient bitmap merging.
- Includes solutions for text-to-int UID encoding for compatibility with bitmap operations.
- Advanced triggers and usage guidance for deduplication and high-cardinality analytics scenarios.
